نشتغل (form VIII)
# نَشْتَغِلُ (naštaḡilu) /naʃ.ta.ɣi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَغَلَ (ištaḡala)
# نَشْتَغِلَ (naštaḡila) /naʃ.ta.ɣi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَغَلَ (ištaḡala)
# نَشْتَغِلْ (naštaḡil) /naʃ.ta.ɣil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِشْتَغَلَ (ištaḡala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
